proposal: Adopt a conservative publication lag: each daily snapshot is treated as available only from snapshot_date + 1 day (00:00 UTC), recording an explicit availability timestamp per snapshot.
reason: CryptWatch provides no per-snapshot publication/availability timestamp. A +1-day lag is an unverified assumption, not source evidence; it cannot distinguish (a) snapshots published later than the assumed lag, (b) retroactive revisions/backfills, or (c) restatements. The historical-universe skill requires publication-time availability derived from source metadata, not an invented lag. Therefore the gate cannot be flipped to PASS on this basis; status remains BLOCKED_DATA_GATE.
mitigation_noted: The +1-day lag may be used only as a research-side conservative filter AFTER a source with verified publication timestamps is found; it is not itself gate evidence.
